title: Resort Lodging Unit Type Specification Sheet
content:
What each Resort Lodging unit type actually holds is set out below: the number of bedrooms, the number of bathrooms, the cooking facilities it carries, the mountains of the collective it exists at, the hot tub it has access to, whether slopeside ski storage and boot warming is included with it and the nightly charge where it is not, whether the mountain shuttle serves it at no charge, and how often the unit is serviced during a stay.

| Unit type | Bedrooms | Bathrooms | Cooking facilities | Hot tub | Ski valet included | Ski valet nightly charge (USD) | Shuttle included | Servicing during the stay |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 0 | 1 | none | none | no | 22.00 | yes | daily |
| Slopeside Studio | 0 | 1 | kitchenette | shared | no | 22.00 | yes | every third day |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 1 | 1 | full kitchen | shared | yes | 0 | yes | every third day |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 2 | 2 | full kitchen | shared | yes | 0 | yes | every third day |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 2 | 2 | kitchenette | shared | yes | 0 | yes | daily |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 3 | 3.5 | full kitchen | private | yes | 0 | yes | daily |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 5 | 5.5 | full kitchen | private | yes | 0 | no | on request |

## Where each unit type exists

| Unit type | Mountains of the collective |
| --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Copper Hollow |
| Slopeside Studio | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Copper Hollow |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | Granite Ridge, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | Granite Ridge, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | Granite Ridge, Silverpine Basin |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak |
| Private Mountain Chalet | Talon Peak |

### Notes on reading the sheet

A unit type showing no bedrooms is a single room or studio in which the sleeping space is the living space. Cooking facilities are recorded in three forms only: none, a kitchenette, or a full kitchen. Ski valet carries a nightly charge of 22.00 USD for the two unit types it is not included with, and no charge for the five it is included with.
